thesis: The bull carried the debate because current operating evidence is unusually strong: high margins, large free cash flow, low leverage, and dated Q2/GPU demand evidence. This is a low-conviction buy bias, not a precise trade call, because technical coverage is incomplete and forward valuation depends on sustained AI-capex execution.
strongest_counterexample: If hyperscaler demand or earnings growth decelerates faster than the forward P/E assumes, the stock can undergo a material multiple reset despite retaining excellent margins and balance-sheet strength.
invalidation_conditions: Gross margin falls below 65% for two consecutive reported quarters.
Trailing free cash flow falls below $75B for two consecutive Layer 1 refreshes.
The recommendation mix develops at least 10 sell-or-worse ratings or broad downward revisions.
A complete future technical snapshot confirms a sustained break below long-term trend support while fundamentals weaken.
evidence_gaps: SMA/RSI/Bollinger/ATR/support/resistance are unavailable after the non-finite 2026-08-28 bar.
Layer 1 has no customer-level order visibility or segment-growth decomposition.
There is no dated USD/MYR trend series, only the 2026-09-02 reference.
decisive_factors: $96.7B free cash flow with approximately 7% debt/equity.
Fresh public Q2 revenue and GPU-demand evidence.
Technical incompleteness prevented a high-confidence or precise-level ruling.
